## Summary
The Hotel holds 10 double rooms a night for Teuta Travel from 1 April to 31 October 2027 at EUR 82 with breakfast. We pay a EUR 6,000 deposit that we cannot get back, and each stay is paid at check-out. The main concerns: if the Hotel cannot give us a room it only offers another hotel, its liability is capped at the value of the stay, and the contract renews by itself.

## Key terms
| Term | What the contract says | Clause |
|---|---|---|
| Allotment | 10 double rooms per night, EUR 82, breakfast included | 1 |
| Deposit | EUR 6,000 (40% of estimated season value), non-refundable, due within 7 days of signing, paid to [bank details masked] | 2 |
| Stay payment | Invoiced at check-in, payable at check-out | 3 |
| Release | Free up to 21 days before arrival, then the first night is charged | 4 |
| Prices | Fixed for the season, tourist tax added | 5 |
| Term | To 31 October 2027, renews automatically unless 90 days' notice | 8 |
| Law | Albanian law, courts of Durrës | 9 |

## Risk checklist
| # | Check | Result | Severity | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Payment timing | Pass | Medium | Paid at check-out (cl. 3) |
| 2 | Deposit | Flag | Medium | 40% and non-refundable (cl. 2) |
| 3 | Our cancellation rights | Pass | High | Free release to 21 days (cl. 4) |
| 4 | Supplier cannot deliver | Flag | High | Only offers another hotel, nothing further owed (cl. 6) |
| 5 | Term and renewal | Flag | Medium | Auto-renews, 90 days' notice (cl. 8) |
| 6 | Price changes | Pass | Medium | Fixed; tourist tax passes through (cl. 5) |
| 7 | Liability and insurance | Flag | High | Capped at the stay amount, no insurance mentioned (cl. 7) |
| 8 | Governing law | Pass | Medium | Albanian law, Durrës courts (cl. 9) |

## Questions for the supplier
- Can the deposit be lower, or credited against stays if we release rooms in time?
- If you cannot provide a room, will you pay the extra cost of the replacement hotel?
- Does the Hotel carry liability insurance, and will it remove the cap for injury to guests?
- Can renewal require our written agreement, or the notice period be 60 days?

## Sign-off
Needs legal review: Yes, because two High checks are flagged (4 and 7). This is a summary, not legal advice. Only the Manager signs.
